'''Zero-gee maneuvering jets''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] equipment and locomotion system. Due to the ease with which [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were able to be upgraded and adjusted, some units were known to have been modified with zero-gee maneuvering jets as part of their equipment loadout. [[12-4C-41 traffic control droid]]s were also equipped with zero-gee maneuvering jets, allowing them to move freely through the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGTD" />
